fullDescription: A standalone testimonial COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: A heading and lede on the left, a quote card with a star rating on the right, changed by dot pagination. The card carries five stars, the quote, and an avatar built from initials so the component ships with no image dependency. Dots are real buttons with aria-current. Content cross-fades rather than snapping. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A self-contained testimonial component. A heading and lede on the left, a quote card with a star rating on the right, changed by dot pagination. The card carries five stars, the quote, and an avatar built from initials so the component ships with no image dependency. Dots are real buttons with aria-current. Content cross-fades rather than snapping. The page contains the component and nothing else, so it can be lifted straight into a section.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Component
The card carries five stars, the quote, and an avatar built from initials so the component ships with no image dependency. Dots are real buttons with aria-current. Content cross-fades rather than snapping.

### Responsive
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.

### Reduced motion
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A heading and lede on the left, a quote card with a star rating on the right, changed by dot pagination.

### Componente
Initial-based avatars with no image dependency

### Componente
Reduced-motion fallback that changes the layout, not just the timing
